page: Microsoft Azure L96s_v4 is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is powered by a dedicated 48-core, 96-thread Intel Xeon 8573C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture with a clock speed of 4.2 GHz, 260 MB of L3 cache, and support for AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets. Memory capacity is provisioned at 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation of 8.0 GB per physical core. The hardware configuration bundles 23,038 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and operates without discrete hardware acceleration, featuring zero GPUs.

Benchmark data demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded compute and throughput capabilities. The platform achieves a PassMark CPU score of 85,426.93 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 21,790.0, both ranking within the top ten percent of tested systems. Memory bandwidth benchmarks indicate uncached read throughput of 222.04 GB/s and write throughput of 94.04 GB/s. In transactional tests, the instance executed 102.15 million Redis SET operations per second and delivered 113.25 GB/s in static web serving throughput.

The integration of substantial local NVMe capacity directly beside high core density offers strong efficiency for disk-bound infrastructure, reducing dependency on networked storage fabrics. While single-thread benchmarks place in the average-to-strong tiers, parallel execution and I/O capacity are exceptionally dense. This profile suits large-scale distributed databases, data warehousing, high-throughput caching tiers, and data analytics pipelines requiring significant local scratch capacity.
description: Microsoft Azure L96s_v4 is a high-density, storage-optimized instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V platform. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8573C processor featuring 48 physical cores, 96 vCPUs at 4.2 GHz, 260 MB of L3 cache, and 768.0 GB of system RAM. Hardware storage is directly provisioned through 23,038 GB of fast local NVMe SSD capacity, with no discrete GPUs attached. Benchmark evaluations highlight top-tier multi-core computing metrics alongside strong memory throughput, registering an uncached read rate of 222.04 GB/s and 102.15 million Redis SET operations per second. The instance delivers cost-effective density by pairing massive local read/write storage directly with broad multi-threaded CPU execution. Azure L96s_v4 is purpose-built for enterprise transactional databases, high-capacity distributed cache layers, data warehousing, and intensive transactional analytical workloads.
